eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 39 · Grouping and Aggregating

code:
SELECT VAR(ListPrice) AS PriceVariance
FROM Production.Product;
caption: How far values sit from the mean, on average — squared, so it's in "squared" units.

code:
SELECT STDEV(ListPrice) AS PriceStdDev
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Square root of variance — back to plain dollars, not dollars-squared.

code:
SELECT Color, AVG(ListPrice) AS AvgPrice,
       STDEV(ListPrice) AS PriceStdDev
FROM Production.Product
WHERE Color IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Color
HAVING STDEV(ListPrice) > 200;
caption: Skips NULL, works with GROUP BY and HAVING — same rules as every aggregate this chapter.

subtitle: Wrapping up Chapter 4 by combining everything you've learned.
